description: This file contains implementation of the 'unit' class and related functions for the Wesnoth game, including unit creation, modification, state management, and interactions within the game map.

classes.name: unit
classes.description: Represents a game unit with properties, state, and behaviors such as movement, combat, and modifications.

classes.name: team
classes.description: Represents a team in the game, used for calculating team data.

classes.name: gamemap::location
classes.description: Represents a location on the game map.

classes.name: attack_type
classes.description: Represents an attack type with properties like id, range, and animation.

classes.name: unit_animation
classes.description: Represents animation frames for units during actions like defending or attacking.

methods.name: generate_gender
methods.description: Generates a gender for a unit based on its type and optional random choice.

methods.name: generate_traits
methods.description: Calculates and applies traits to a unit based on its type.

methods.name: apply_modifications
methods.description: Applies modifications to a unit, affecting stats and abilities.

methods.name: remove_temporary_modifications
methods.description: Removes non-permanent modifications from a unit.

methods.name: heal_all
methods.description: Restores a unit's hitpoints to maximum.
